text_en: “I know that you can do all things, and that no purpose of yours can be thwarted.
text_cn: 我知道你事事都能，你所有的计划，没有不实现的。

text_en: ‘Who is this that hides counsel without knowledge? ’ Therefore I have uttered what I did not understand, things too wonderful for me, which I did not know.
text_cn: 是我以无智的话，使你的计划模糊不明；是我说了无知的话，说了那些超越我智力的话。

text_en: ‘Hear, and I will speak; I will question you, and you declare to me. ’
text_cn: 请你听我发言；我求你指教我。

text_en: I had heard of you by the hearing of the ear, but now my eye sees you;
text_cn: 以前我只听见了有关你的事，现今我亲眼见了你。

text_en: therefore I despise myself, and repent in dust and ashes. ”
text_cn: 为此，我收回我所说过的话，坐在灰尘中忏悔。

text_en: After the Lord had spoken these words to Job, the Lord said to Eliphaz the Temanite: “My wrath is kindled against you and against your two friends; for you have not spoken of me what is right, as my servant Job has.
text_cn: 上主对约伯说完这些话，就对特曼人厄里法次说：“我应向你和你的两个友人发怒，因为你们讲论我，不如我仆约伯讲论的正确。

text_en: Now therefore take seven bulls and seven rams, and go to my servant Job, and offer up for yourselves a burnt offering; and my servant Job shall pray for you, for I will accept his prayer not to deal with you according to your folly; for you have not spoken of me what is right, as my servant Job has done. ”
text_cn: 现在你们要牵七头公牛，和七只公羊到我仆约伯那里，叫他为你们奉献全燔祭，也叫他为你们祈祷，因为我要看他的情面，不惩罚你们的糊涂，因为你们讲论我，不如我仆约伯讲的正确。”

text_en: So Eliphaz the Temanite and Bildad the Shuhite and Zophar the Naamathite went and did what the Lord had told them; and the Lord accepted Job’s prayer.
text_cn: 于是，特曼人厄里法次、叔亚人彼耳达得、纳阿玛人左法尔依照上主所吩咐的作了；上主就看了约伯的情面，饶恕了他们。

text_en: And the Lord restored the fortunes of Job when he had prayed for his friends; and the Lord gave Job twice as much as he had before.
text_cn: 约伯为他的朋友祈祷之后，上主就恢复了约伯原有的状况，还照约伯以前所有的，加倍地赐给了他。

text_en: Then there came to him all his brothers and sisters and all who had known him before, and they ate bread with him in his house; they showed him sympathy and comforted him for all the evil that the Lord had brought upon him; and each of them gave him a piece of money and a gold ring.
text_cn: 约伯的兄弟和姊妹，并以前相识的人都来看望他，在他家中同他一起用饭；对于上主降于他的一切灾祸，都向他表示同情，安慰他；每人还赠给他一枚金币和一个金戒指。

text_en: The Lord blessed the latter days of Job more than his beginning; and he had fourteen thousand sheep, six thousand camels, a thousand yoke of oxen, and a thousand donkeys.
text_cn: 上主赐给约伯以后的福分，远胜过以前所有的；他拥有一万四千只羊，六千匹骆驼，一千对牛，一千头母驴。

text_en: He also had seven sons and three daughters.
text_cn: 他又生了七个儿子和三个女儿。

text_en: He named the first Jemimah, the second Keziah, and the third Keren-happuch.
text_cn: 他给长女起名叫耶米玛，次女叫刻漆雅，三女叫刻楞哈普客。

text_en: In all the land there were no women so beautiful as Job’s daughters; and their father gave them an inheritance along with their brothers.
text_cn: 那地方的女子没有比约伯的女儿更美丽的；他们的父亲也使她们和兄弟们一样承受家产。

text_en: After this Job lived one hundred and forty years, and saw his children, and his children’s children, four generations.
text_cn: 以后，约伯又活了一百四十岁，见了他的儿子、孙子，直到第四代。

text_en: And Job died, old and full of days.
text_cn: 约伯寿高年老，已享天年，遂与世长辞。
